description: Information about an ontology used in the metadata: a map from the version-agnostic URL to a versioned URL. Version pinning is real work for deposit documents — the OWL versionIRI mechanism serves the same purpose at the ontology level.

namespace.description: The CURIE namespace (prefix) an ontology (e.g. "GO" for Gene Ontology).

ontology_url.description: The version-agnostic URL of the ontology (e.g. the IRI of the ontology in OWL).

versioned_ontology_url.description: The versioned URL of the ontology (e.g. the "versionIRI" in OWL).

title: OntologyVersions
